issues.title: MY2008 9-5 transmission overheating versus temperature sensor and protection events
issues.cause: Temperature-dependent lockup, TORQUE LIMIT and P0218 can reflect actual overheating; separate P0711/12/13 concern temperature-sensor signals.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Stop operating an overheating car; verify actual ATF level, coolant/ATF cooler lines, TCM live temperature, NTC plausible response against coolant/ambient and records before making transmission repair choice.
issues.correction_summary: Address confirmed cooling, fluid, sensor or wiring condition; only consider overhaul/complete replacement with evidence of internal damage, recurrence, or qualified transmission diagnosis.
limits: Protective thresholds are not recommended operating temperatures or a way to force a fault for testing.
Sensor DTC is not itself proof of thermal damage.
No factory replacement authorization or current ATF compatibility established.

issues.title: MY2008–09 9-5 selector and output signal codes can imitate catastrophic gearbox failure
issues.cause: Separate DTC pages describe invalid range switch code combinations (P0705, MY2008) or missing output shaft sensor signal (P0722, MY2009).
issues.diagnosis_summary: Use TCM read-values / switch statuses, physical connector and harness checks, verify ignition/ground and gearbox type before investigating actual clutch/band slipping.
issues.correction_summary: Correct confirmed selector/speed electrical fault when repairable; refer persistent mechanical ratio/contamination evidence for specialized inspection.
limits: DTC absence does not certify a gearbox.
2008 and 2009 DTC pages individually sourced; applicability cannot be turned into an identical-year component supersession.
Do not command solenoids when drive wheels can move.

issues.title: Wastegate clip bulletin 291-2317 excludes MY2007 US/CA B235R blanket applicability
issues.cause: The bulletin printed in the MY2007 web directory was originally dated January 2002 for non-US/CA 9-5 B205E/B235E; earlier dataset wrongly generalized its symptom webpage.
issues.diagnosis_summary: Look at actuator clip/arm and bypass path on relevant original vehicle, but independently identify installed turbo engine and market before selecting service kit.
issues.correction_summary: Bulletin-specific clip and O-ring are possible in-scope repair; do not authorize B235R or American-market part fitment based on unrelated mirrored file path.
limits: Document does not list a model-year cutoff; no retrospective 2007 affected fleet claims.
Canadian part-number notation in this non-US/CA bulletin is not sufficient evidence to override the Market exclusion.
Clip fault can be one possible cause without proving turbo mechanical damage.

parts.title: Stainless wastegate pushrod clip, restricted factory bulletin 291-2317
requirements: This original bulletin is expressly non-US/CA and B205E/B235E; excludes B235R.
Confirm actual original OEM part identity, remaining stock/supersession and hardware/variant by Saab WebEPC before a 2026 repair.
Do not assume (CA: 30567751) note grants a Canadian-market fitment.
parts.notes: Factory-specified historic part for specific reported symptom and bulletin. Not proven universal/reliability upgrade; no vehicle VIN observed.

parts.title: Bypass pipe O-ring, restricted bulletin 291-2317
requirements: Bulletin service component only, not a general MY2007 turbo O-ring cross-fit.
Verify current OEM mapping to exact B205E/B235E turbo and bypass pipe.
Do not interpret parenthesized (CA: 30588378) as Canadian market authorization.
parts.notes: Factory historic part only for narrowly scoped bulletin; not a cross-engine supersession or B235R fitment claim.
